title: Chekushka
description: This mod adds a chekushka for the brewin' and chewin' mod. The chekushka can be used for pouring vodka, and in future updates, other drinks can be used.
body: This is a small addon for the brewin and chewin mod (addon to the farmer's delight mod) that will add a chekushka that can be used for bottling vodka, the mod was made in honor of the chekushka day on June 16th.
